               gsum pa grangs nges pa'i rigs pa la 
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3840">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3840">dan</rs></note> na re mtshan nyid du bkod pa gang zhig spyir don ldog kyans par ma grub pa dang grub pa 2 las | dang po ni rang ldog rdzas med yin la br ba la rang gi mtshon bya de'i don ldog ma yin pa dang yin pa 2 su nges la | dang po ni don ldog
               <lb edRef="inst:5508" n="18b5"/>gzhan gyur yin la 2 pa gzhir byas la mtshan gzhi la ji ltar bkod pa ltar ma grub pa dang grub pa 2 su nges la | dang po mtshan nyid mtshan gzhi la mi srid pa 2 pa mtshan nyid skyon med de ltar rnams bcad la skyon 3 du grangs nges la yongs cod la mtshan nyid skyon med 1 du grub pa'o ||</seg></TEI>
